body:
**Starts** once #48 is merged.

## Why

This is the first version Joe can use. Until now, the coordinator runs only in the terminal (#48). This issue lets a signed-in user plan a trip in the browser, with trips and sessions saved, so a conversation can be left and picked up again.

## Design

- [Systems design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/systems.md), sections 3 and 4.
- [Persistence design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/persistence.md), sections 8.2 and 8.5.
- [Functional spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/functional-spec.md), sections 2, 3, and 10.1.

## Open questions

- None.

## Do

- Add the endpoints: list the user's trips, with name, dates, and last updated; start a trip from the "New trip" form; list a trip's sessions; send a message, with the reply streamed back over Server-Sent Events; and resume a session.
- Check that the signed-in user owns the trip before making a session's MCP servers (tool design, section 4).
- Keep a turn running when the browser disconnects.
- Refuse to start or resume a session, or take a message, once the trip has started. Check before each message.
- Add the home screen: the user's trips, and "New trip."
- Add the trip page: its sessions, with date and title, each with resume, plus "start a new session." Add the chat view, showing the reply as it streams in.

## Done when

- Tests with a fake in place of the Agent SDK (DEVELOPMENT.md section 5) show that another user's trip is refused.
- A stream closed partway through a turn still leaves the whole turn in the transcript.
- A started trip refuses a new message.
- On the deployed site after the merge (systems design, section 7), Joe signs in, starts a trip, and goes through discovery.
- After a reload, resuming the session restores the conversation.
- A new session on the same trip knows the trip brief and memory.
- The second test user, which Joe added in Supabase for isolation tests, sees none of Joe's trips, and the coordinator knows none of his preferences (functional spec 11, S8).
- Closing the tab partway through a reply, then coming back, shows the finished reply.

## Ends in

A PR. This is the first version Joe can use.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.

---

Moved from the [development plan](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/plan/development-plan.md#phase-14-chat-in-the-browser).
